summary: Reproduced the review's direct-loader counterexamples against candidate 74ec83a. Preserved its valid backend-selection fix and replaced the unconstrained hand-sized loader fixture with production DeepSeek-V4 FlashInfer CUTLASS MXFP4 weight creation plus independent model-shape boundaries. No production correction is justified without the checkpoint and SM90 execution.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact candidate's four direct-loader TP-rank cases passed before correction.
The candidate fixture pattern accepted 2048/128, 1024/64, and 2048/127 when destinations were hand-sized to match.
Eight corrected tests passed: production-created DSv4 MXFP4 buffer shapes, reported TP=4 sharding, two counterexample boundaries, a distinct valid hidden-size relationship, and backend selection.
The real SM90 FlashInfer preprocessing/kernel suite was attempted and skipped at module scope on the AMD host.
A real MI350X gfx950 float32 matmul matched its CPU reference (max absolute difference 7.62939453125e-06).
Formatting tool availability; ruff is not installed in the prepared interpreter.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 executed a 64x64 float32 matmul matching a CPU reference; this is not SM90-path evidence.
remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950, not NVIDIA SM90; FlashInfer Hopper preprocessing and kernel execution remain unverified.
Four-way H800 TP, full checkpoint loading, DSPARK, HTTP serving, and semantic accuracy remain unverified.
The generic shard copier intentionally does not infer a model hidden size; correctness is established by production buffer construction, not by arbitrary hand-sized destinations.
ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter.
